release.notes:
When you link your assistant, o7 now gives it a skill that teaches it how to hand o7 whole tasks, along with a few things to try.
An assistant that runs on your computer, like Hermes or OpenClaw, can now reach o7 directly, without going through the internet.
A chat your assistant or an automation starts now asks before changing anything unless the link may approve, even when your projects start chats with full access.
New.
When a task your assistant started opens a pull request, o7 watches it and tells your assistant when its checks fail or pass, when someone reviews or comments, and when it is merged.
Your assistant can leave work for tonight.
With full control, your assistant can now see a picture of a chat's web page or emulator, to check that the work looks right.
o7 can open when you sign in to your computer, in the background, and keep the computer awake while your phone or a bot can reach it.
And 3 more.
